lines.en: label halloweenfour6:
scene toukamaskwkirin1
: Well, well, well. What do we have here? A vulnerable, yet lecherous teacher out in the wild and not being bombarded by an onslaught of hormonal teenage girls?
: Why would you ask if you already know?
: Because I’m worried about you, of course. Something appears to be wrong, but I also know that means you’re not going to be talking about it any time soon.
: Observant as ever, I see.
scene toukamaskwkirin2

: It’s in my blood, I suppose. I’m sure it goes without saying at this point, but I take after my mother in a multitude of ways. Our affinity for watching is just one of many traits I’ve luckily inherited.
: Or trained in as I’m pretty sure she’s just groomed you into a mini-Tsubasa by now.
scene toukamaskwkirin1
: We still disagree when it comes to...certain things. But that’s not something I’d like to get into at this very moment.
: Tell me. What’s wrong?
: Sensei, as someone who very recently played the role of your mother in a rather strange contest, I can assure you that whatever it is you have to say will not fall into the hands of anyone else.
: Granted, I did lose that contest. So whether or not you actually want to divulge anything to me remains to be seen.
scene toukamaskwkirin3
: But I suppose, if nothing else, I could sink my nails into your back again? They’re extra sharp tonight.
: Sure. So long as you don’t mind doing it with your legs wrapped around my waist at the same time.
scene toukamaskwkirin4
: I can’t tell what expression you’re making beneath that mask.
: I’m aware. That’s why I elected to not say anything. I was interested in seeing if you had anything else to add before I decimated your hopes and dreams.
: I think I made my intentions pretty clear just now. No further clarification is needed.
: All you “made clear” is your determination to keep running, no matter what it is you’re running from.
: Well, I suppose you did also make your attraction to me clear. But, let’s be honest, we both already knew that was there to begin with.
: You really are like a mom sometimes, Touka.

: That’s a very strange thing to say just moments after asking to bed me. Though, I suppose I have heard something in the past about the Oedipus complex being closer to the truth than one would expect.
: Am I to act as your shoulder or not, Sensei?
: Give me a role to play and I will play it. Because Lord knows it beats standing off to the side and watching you roam around the room like some sort of malfunctioning robot.
: Do you want to...leave this place together?
: Right now?
: Yeah. Right now.
: And go where?
: Anywhere. Your room. My house. That new apartment you got me.
: Am I truly the one you wish to leave here with?
: In the sense that I’m in love with you or something? No.
: But in the sense that I feel eerily safe whenever I’m with you, yes. I want you by my side until this all boils over.
: And if it never does, will we remain together forever?
: If it’s not too much trouble.
scene toukamaskwkirin5
: That does sound rather troublesome, if I’m being honest. I do believe I’d run out of buttons for you to push within weeks. I’m not sure how much fun it would be for either one of us.
: Do you want to leave or not? You wanted a role to play and I’m giving you one.
: If you want my honest answer, yes. I would like that.
: Then-
: But it’s not going to happen.
: Why?
scene toukamaskwkirin6
: Because, unlike you, I’m capable of thinking several steps ahead and know that leaving here with you would do naught but distract you for an hour at the most. Perhaps even less.
: Then, can you do me a favor and utilize this amazing foresight of yours to figure out the several steps I need to follow to start feeling like I’m supposed to be here?
: Which here are you referring to, Sensei?
: Is it the party?
: Or is it something else?
: I don’t know.
: I have no idea.
: You poor thing.
: Your pity isn’t going to help, Touka.
: It’s not pity.
: We’ve not known one another for long. But, in the time we have spent together, I have witnessed several low points of yours. Nothing like this, though. You look...
: Well, for lack of better phrasing, you look like Yasu.
: Okay, now that’s just rude.
: I mean it, Sensei. You may not be...staring at the walls or...ranting about religious idols or anything of the sort, but there’s a hint of emptiness and longing in your eyes that...
: That makes me feel lonely.
: I can’t leave this place with you...as I know that I am not the one who can fill that void. That responsibility will fall on someone else in due time.
: But I’ll remain by your side until they appear if that is what you want instead.
: I can’t make you do that, Touka. I’m not the only one you’re responsible for babysitting after all.
: Plus, I have Ami to watch over me if it really comes down to it.
scene toukamaskwkirin7
: Then I suppose I’ll just have to accept you choosing her over me a second time. You’re more of an...Aphrodite than an Oedipus it seems.

: As someone who is formerly well-read but hasn’t touched a book or looked into anything involving Greek mythology in many years, I’m just going to assume I should be a little offended here and leave it at that.
: That seems like a reasonable decision to me. But it calls into question — what are we to discuss now that we’re beginning to drift away from the ever-growing list of mysteries that ail you?
: We don’t have to talk at all. Let’s just hold hands and gaze into each other’s eyes. I’m sure that won’t set off any alarms in here.
scene toukamaskwkirin8
: Hahah...as if. I’m sure the sprinklers would go off within seconds if such a thing were to happen.
: Yeah. I wouldn’t be surprised if Ayane had her butler watching my every move via security camera as we speak.
scene toukamaskwkirin9
: Us wealthy people do love our security cameras. That doesn’t seem all that unreasonable to me.
: That’s not really something I’m comfortable hearing from my landlady.
: Your what?
scene toukamaskwkirin10
: Oh dear. This is going to be problematic, isn’t it?
: Yeah. I find that most things with Kirin are.
scene toukamaskwkirin11
: Oh, come on. I’m not that bad. I just like keeping things a little exciting.
: Now, what were you two talking about just now? Something about Touka being your landlady? Is that slang for something? Has Sensei finally conquered the queen of Kumon-mi?
: “Conquered” meaning what, exactly?
scene toukamaskwkirin12
: Has his penis “entered” your “vagina?”
: Kirin, come on.
: Hey, I think that’s a reasonable question when it comes to you. Plus, you two have been over here chatting up a storm for like ten minutes now. Something’s gotta be going on.
: No, Kirin. I regret to inform you that I have not had sexual intercourse with the teacher. I sincerely apologize if that upsets you.
scene toukamaskwkirin13
: Don’t apologize to her. She’s just trying to start problems.
: It doesn’t upset me. It is a boring answer, though.
: And no, I’m not trying to start problems. Noriko’s just with Uta right now and I didn’t know who else to talk to.
scene toukamaskwkirin14
: Does that also explain why you’ve taken it upon yourself to constrict his arm like a boa?
: No. That I’m doing because I want him to put his penis inside of my vagina.
: You really need to stop saying things like that to your classmates, Kirin.
: Maybe under normal circumstances. But I think I’ve just uncovered some hot gossip between you two and can now say a whole bunch of stuff since I can use this new info as a bargaining chip.
: Weren’t you trying to be, like...a better person or something?
scene toukamaskwkirin15
: Mhm! But it’s not like I’m going to just turn into an angel overnight. My love for mischief is what makes me me after all.
: So, go on. What’s this landlady stuff about? Did the Tsukiokas buy out your neighborhood or something? Are they making a new mall there? What’s the deal?
: The deal is that you should mind your own business and forget you heard anything.
: And let my bargaining chip expire? Nuh-uh. I need something to keep my lips sealed, Sensei.
: You don’t even know what you’re keeping them sealed about. Just that, in some regard, I am in charge of a property that Sensei inhabits. Which could mean essentially anything.
: Does Ami know?
scene toukamaskwkirin16
: Heheheh...
: Hah...go on. Name your price. How much do you want?
scene toukamaskwkirin17
: Golly gee! I get to pick?! Yay!
: Are you really going to do this? Can’t you just leave us alone?
scene toukamaskwkirin18
: Would it make you feel better if I chose something easy?
: Like?
: Liiiiiiiiiike...
: A kiss?
scene toukamaskwkirin19
: Have at it. Though, I do hope the Amamiya family butler happens to be looking away when it happens.
: Fine. We’ll have to go somewhere private, though.
: Hm?
: Oh. Not with me. I meant you and Touka.
scene toukamaskwkirin20
: Um...you do realize Touka is me, correct? I am her. That is my name.
: Mhm!
: And...And why do you want us to kiss, exactly? What do you get out of this?
: I just think it would be cute. Like a mother kissing her son. There doesn’t need to be tongue or anything. I won’t complain if there is, though. In fact, I say go for it.
scene toukamaskwkirin21
: I’m waaaaaaiting...
: We’re in a room full of people right now.
: Surely that isn’t the only issue you have with this, is it?
: It’s certainly the most damning and potentially destructive of them.
scene toukamaskwkirin22
: I wouldn’t be so sure about that if I were you.
: Oh damn! She’s actually going for it. I just wanted to see her get all bashful and scurry off.
: I’ll say to you the same thing I said to Kirin. If we’re really going to do this, we need to go somewhere private and-
scene toukamaskwkirin23
: Am I pretty?
scene toukamaskwkirin24
: I’m tapping out.
: Yeah, that’s fair. I’ve seen enough.
scene toukamaskwkirin25
: Well, I hope you had your fun ruining an important conversation in the name of unwanted, mischievous antics.
: Hey, it’s not my fault I just happened to overhear what I assumed was a pretty big deal. It’s not every day that you find out your teacher is paying rent to a student.
scene toukamaskwkirin26
: He’s not paying me anything. He just has a second room at an apartment complex I purchased that I gifted to him on Christmas of last year.
: Wait, you’re letting him crash there for free?!
: Can you not just tell that to people, please?
: She’s already caught on, Sensei. If anything, this saves you the hassle of having her pester you about it until you ultimately break.
: You have enough going on to begin with and I don’t want to add more fuel to the fire when you’re already as...Yasu-ish as you’ve been tonight.
: Touka-
scene toukamaskwkirin27
: A question for you, Sensei. Would you still like me to remain by your side until you’re feeling better? Or would you rather try your chances with the boa instead?
: Let me...talk to Kirin for now and I’ll catch up with you again in a minute. Don’t go too far.
: I’ll go take a seat at my table. Please do try not to get bitten in the meantime.
scene toukamaskwkirin28
Touka goes back to her seat and-
: What the hell was that about?
scene toukamaskwkirin29
And now I have to deal with this.
: I think a better question is why you had to get yourself involved instead of just waiting for your turn.
: I’ve been waiting for my turn ever since you got here. But more importantly than that, what the crap is going on with you and Touka?
: “Don’t go too far?” Remaining by your side? You really are fucking her, aren’t you?
: I’ve never done anything with her. I’ve just...felt like shit since I woke up. And the way she treats me makes me feel a little better sometimes.
: You know, I said that “mother kissing her son” thing as a joke, but now it’s starting to sound like I wasn’t too far off.
: Also, what’s wrong? Is there anything I can do to make you feel better? It doesn’t have to be Touka, does it?
: I don’t think there’s anything you can do, Kirin. And I’m not sure there’s anything Touka could have done either.
: I think this is something I’ve just got to...wait out.
scene toukamaskwkirin30
: Want to dance again? I can play Despacito on my phone. That is our song and all.
: I really hate how that is the song we wound up “dancing” to, but no. I’m fine just...hanging out over here and only associating with the people who come to me.
scene toukamaskwkirin31
: Would you mind at least delivering that memo to Noriko? Because she’s also been “waiting for her turn” all night and you’ve yet to even look at her.
: I’m looking at her right now.
scene toukamaskwkirin32
: And?
: Are you just going to let her wait?
: Sensei, she’s not going to come up to you tonight. She wants you to make the first move for once since she’s, and I quote, “Always bothering you at things like this.”
: I don’t know if I’d say she “bothers me,” but...
: But what?...
scene black
: She looks too much like someone else I want to see right now.
: And it makes everything worse.
